brief: My wellness stack — 5 things that actually moved the needle.

slots.headline: What Changed the Game?
slots.subtitle: Five habits that actually moved the needle on my health.

slots.title: Prioritize Deep Sleep
slots.body: I used to brag about five-hour nights. Then I tracked my focus: trash. Eight hours is now my non-negotiable baseline. Everything else stacks on top.

slots.title: Get Morning Sunlight
slots.body: Ten minutes within an hour of waking anchors my circadian rhythm. Coffee second, light first. My mood and energy shifted within a week.

slots.title: Lift Heavy Things
slots.body: Cardio made me tired; lifting made me capable. Three sessions a week rebuilt my metabolism and posture. It is the ultimate longevity hack.

slots.title: Eat More Protein
slots.body: Aiming for thirty grams per meal killed the afternoon crash. It takes effort, but muscle and satiety are worth the grocery bill.

slots.title: Set a Digital Sunset
slots.body: Blue light after 9 PM was wrecking my REM. Now screens go dark one hour before bed. The difference in morning clarity is unreal.

slots.title: Stay Boringly Consistent
slots.body: None of these work in isolation. The magic is doing them when motivation is zero. Stack them daily; the compound effect is undeniable.

slots.headline: Build Your Own Stack
slots.body: Pick one habit. Master it this week, then add another. Small wins compound faster than overnight overhauls.
